summary.en: At around 10pm on September 26, police received a report that a non-Chinese man was suspected to have fallen into the sea and drowned off Wong Shek Pier in Sai Kung. Fire Services divers found the unconscious man, who was taken to Tseung Kwan O Hospital. The case is classified as a drowning for now; police are investigating the cause.

summary.en: A 44-year-old woman has been arrested on suspicion of child abuse after widely circulated dashcam footage appeared to show her shoving a young boy into a metal roadside railing on Wan Chai Road. Police acted after the video drew public attention.
summary.zh_hant: 一名44歲女子涉嫌虐兒被捕。網上廣傳的行車記錄儀片段顯示，她在灣仔道將一名男童推向路邊金屬欄杆，警方接獲關注後採取行動。

summary.en: The Hong Kong Association of Nursing Staff issued five positions on September 26, urging the government to immediately suspend importing non-local nurses via special or limited registration and to uphold a 'local nurses employment first' principle. The association said nurse supply is currently ample and the government should seize the opportunity to hire more local nurses and improve nurse-to-patient ratios in public hospitals.

summary.zh_hant: 香港護士協會9月26日發表5大立場，呼籲政府即時暫緩透過特別或有限度註冊途徑引入非本地護士，堅守「本地護士就業優先」原則。護協指現時護士人手供應充裕，當局應把握時機增聘本地護士，改善公立醫院護士病人比例。

title.en: Nurses association urges government to pause importing non-local nurses, uphold local-first hiring

summary.en: A 49-year-old bar worker was found dead in a Tsim Sha Tsui bar toilet in the early hours of September 24 and allegedly moved onto the street by two colleagues. The pair, aged 28 and 44, were charged with preventing the lawful burial of a body, managing a drug den and trafficking cocaine. They appeared at Fanling Magistrates' Courts on September 26, were denied bail and remanded until December 28. Police seized about 50 grams of suspected crack cocaine and HK$82,000 cash at the bar.
summary.zh_hans: 49岁酒吧男职员9月24日凌晨疑倒毙于尖沙嘴加拿分道一间酒吧厕所，其后被两名同事移至街头。一名28岁男子及一名44岁女子被暂控「阻止合法埋葬尸体」、经营毒窟及贩运危险药物等罪，9月26日在粉岭裁判法院提堂，两人还押至12月28日再讯。警方在酒吧检获约50克怀疑霹雳可卡因及8.2万元现金。
summary.zh_hant: 49歲酒吧男職員9月24日凌晨疑倒斃於尖沙嘴加拿分道一間酒吧廁所，其後被兩名同事移至街頭。一名28歲男子及一名44歲女子被暫控「阻止合法埋葬屍體」、經營毒窟及販運危險藥物等罪，9月26日在粉嶺裁判法院提堂，兩人還押至12月28日再訊。警方在酒吧檢獲約50克懷疑霹靂可卡因及8.2萬元現金。

summary.en: The US 30-year Treasury yield broke above 5.50% on September 25, hitting 5.53% intraday — its highest since 2004 — while the 10-year yield topped 5.22%, a near 19-year high. Strong US economic data and rising rate-hike expectations drove the selloff; Japan's bond yields also hit their highest since 1996.

summary.zh_hant: 9月25日美國30年期國債收益率盤中突破5.50%，最高漲至5.53%，創2004年以來新高；10年期收益率亦升破5.22%，創近19年新高。強勁的美國經濟數據及加息預期升溫推動拋售；日本國債收益率亦升至1996年以來最高。

summary.en: Sik Sik Yuen's Wong Tai Sin Temple is hosting the "Universal Beneficence Mid-Autumn Lantern Carnival" from 17 September to 4 October with free admission. Nearly 30 large lanterns crafted in traditional bamboo-frame art are on display, including Hong Kong's first astronaut-themed lantern, alongside a glow dragon parade, Chinese music performances, stargazing and riddle games. Free glow souvenirs are given to visitors arriving after 6pm nightly.

summary.en: In an NBC interview aired September 25, Bill Gates warned that AI is powerful enough to enable events killing a billion people and that industry self-regulation is not enough. He called for mandatory safeguards with law-enforcement and political involvement, echoing recent warnings from Anthropic's CEO and OpenAI's Sam Altman about slowing frontier AI development.
summary.zh_hans: 微软联合创始人比尔·盖茨在9月25日播出的NBC《与媒体见面》采访中警告，AI是一种「强大到足以导致十亿人死亡的事件」，行业自我监管远远不够。他呼吁执法部门和政界人士参与制定强制性保障与监管要求，此前Anthropic与OpenAI的CEO亦一致呼吁放缓前沿AI研发竞赛。
summary.zh_hant: 微軟聯合創始人比爾·蓋茨在9月25日播出的NBC《與媒體見面》採訪中警告，AI是一種「足夠強大」的工具，「足以引發導致十億人死亡的事件」，行業自我監管遠遠不夠。他呼籲執法部門和政界人士參與制定強制性保障與監管要求，此前Anthropic與OpenAI的CEO亦一致呼籲放緩前沿AI研發競賽。
